verdict.rationale: Fedora docs claim up-to-date packages/toolchains and container tools 'ready with a single command,' supporting general dev tooling currency, but there is no specific evidence about IDEs or AI/ML software availability, and community comments focus on desktop/DE experience rather than dev toolchain currency. missing for 10: explicit mention of IDE support, AI/ML framework packaging (CUDA/PyTorch/etc), and independent corroboration of toolchain freshness; one community note even flags lack of CUDA support as a gap.
